arxiv-2010-01999.title: A Novel Actor Dual-Critic Model for Remote Sensing Image Captioning
arxiv-2010-01999.creator: Ruchika Chavhan 1 , Biplab Banerjee 1 , Xiao Xiang Zhu 2 , Subhasis Chaudhuri 1
arxiv-2010-01999.description: Abstract We deal with the problem of generating textual captions from optical remote sensing (RS) images using the notion of deep reinforcement learning. Due to the high inter-class similarity in reference sentences describing remote sensing data, jointly encoding the sentences and images encourages prediction of captions that are semantically more precise than the ground truth in many cases.

arxiv-2105-08898.title: Leray’s plane stationary solutions at small Reynolds numbers
arxiv-2105-08898.creator: Mikhail Korobkov, Xiao Ren
arxiv-2105-08898.description: Abstract In the celebrated 1933 paper [ 22 ] by J. Leray, the invading domains method was proposed to construct D D -solutions for the stationary Navier-Stokes flow around obstacle problem. In two dimensions, whether Leray’s D D -solution achieves the prescribed limiting velocity at spatial infinity became a major open problem since then.

arxiv-2201-04633.title: Revelation of Task Difficulty in AI-aided Education
arxiv-2201-04633.creator: 1 st Yitzhak Spielberg, 2 nd Amos Azaria
arxiv-2201-04633.description: Abstract When a student is asked to perform a given task, her subjective estimate of the difficulty of that task has a strong influence on her performance. There exists a rich literature on the impact of perceived task difficulty on performance and motivation.

arxiv-2206-10936.title: Information Geometry of Dropout Training
arxiv-2206-10936.creator: Masanari Kimura, Hideitsu Hino
arxiv-2206-10936.description: Abstract Dropout is one of the most popular regularization techniques in neural network training. Because of its power and simplicity of idea, dropout has been analyzed extensively and many variants have been proposed. In this paper, several properties of dropout are discussed in a unified manner from the viewpoint of information geometry.

arxiv-2303-09578.title: Homogeneous sets in hypergraphs with forbidden order-size pairs
arxiv-2303-09578.creator: Maria Axenovich, Dhruv Mubayi, Lea Weber
arxiv-2303-09578.description: Abstract The well-known Erdős-Hajnal conjecture states that for any graph F F , there exists ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0 such that every n n -vertex graph G G that contains no induced copy of F F has a homogeneous set of size at least n ϵ n^{\epsilon} .

arxiv-2403-13044.title: Magic Fixup: Streamlining Photo Editing by Watching Dynamic Videos
arxiv-2403-13044.creator: Hadi Alzayer, Zhihao Xia, Xuaner Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Jia-Bin Huang, Michael Gharbi
arxiv-2403-13044.description: Abstract We propose a generative model that, given a coarsely edited image, synthesizes a photorealistic output that follows the prescribed layout. Our method transfers fine details from the original image and preserve the identity of its parts. Yet, it adapts it to the lighting and context defined by the new layout.

arxiv-2510-19128.title: A Cross-Environment and Cross-Embodiment Path Planning Framework via a Conditional Diffusion Model
arxiv-2510-19128.creator: Mehran Ghafarian Tamizi, Homayoun Honari, Amir Mehdi Soufi Enayati, Aleksey Nozdryn-Plotnicki, Homayoun Najjaran
arxiv-2510-19128.description: Abstract Path planning for a robotic system in high-dimensional cluttered environments needs to be efficient, safe, and adaptable for different environments and hardware. Conventional methods face high computation time and require extensive parameter tuning, while prior learning-based methods still fail to generalize effectively.

arxiv-2601-19396.title: Mikado strategy for the detection of atoms in images of microtrap arrays
arxiv-2601-19396.creator: Marc Cheneau, François Goudail
arxiv-2601-19396.description: Abstract Building on top of our recent work 2 , we introduce a new strategy to solve the problem of detecting atoms in high-resolution images of microtrap arrays. By alternating estimation and detection steps, we get rid of the need for an explicit model to compute the posterior occupancy probability of each site given its a priori optimal estimate.

arxiv-2602-19724.title: Anisotropic fully-gapped superconductivity in quasi-one-dimensional Li 0.9 Mo 6 O 17
arxiv-2602-19724.creator: M. J. Grant, T. M. Huijbregts, R. Nicholls, M. Greenblatt, P. Chudzinski, A. Carrington, N. E. Hussey
arxiv-2602-19724.description: Abstract Superconductivity in quasi-one-dimensional Li 0.9 Mo 6 O 17 emerges from an exotic, non-metallic normal state that exhibits signatures of Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid behavior, emergent symmetry and excitonic order. The high upper critical field, H c ​ 2 H_{c2} , in Li 0.9 Mo 6 O 17 suggests that that the favored pairing state is spin-triplet in nature.

britannica-1911-germiston.title: Germiston (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-germiston.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-germiston.description: Article 'Germiston' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 11), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of the municipality (1904) 29,477, of whom 9123 were whites. above the sea, in the heart of the Witwatersrand gold-mining district, and is an important railway junction. The station, formerly called Elandsfontein Junction, is the meeting-point of lines from the ports of the Cape and Natal, and from Johannesburg, Pretoria and Delagoa Bay. Though possessing a separate municipality, Germiston is practically a suburb of Johannesburg (q.v.).

pmc-10619511.title: Online conspiracy communities are more resilient to deplatforming
pmc-10619511.creator: Corrado Monti, Matteo Cinelli, Carlo Valensise, Walter Quattrociocchi, Michele Starnini
pmc-10619511.description: Online social media foster the creation of active communities around shared narratives. Such communities may turn into incubators for conspiracy theories—some spreading violent messages that could sharpen the debate and potentially harm society. To face these phenomena, most social media platforms implemented moderation policies, ranging from posting warning labels up to deplatforming, i.e. permanently banning users.

pmc-10631067.title: Acute renal injury after aortic arch reconstruction with cardiopulmonary bypass for children: prediction models by machine learning of a retrospective cohort study
pmc-10631067.creator: Xiangpan Kong, Lu Zhao, Zhengxia Pan, Hongbo Li, Guanghui Wei, Quan Wang
pmc-10631067.description: BackgroundAcute renal injury (AKI) after aortic arch reconstruction with cardiopulmonary bypass leads to injury of multiple organs and increases perioperative mortality. The study was performed to explore risk factors for AKI. We aim to develop a prediction model that can be used to accurately predict AKI through machine learning (ML).

pmc-10646674.title: Using HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)–Compliant Transcription Services for Virtual Psychiatric Interviews: Pilot Comparison Study
pmc-10646674.creator: Salman Seyedi, Emily Griner, Lisette Corbin, Zifan Jiang, Kailey Roberts, Luca Iacobelli, Aaron Milloy, Mina Boazak, Ali Bahrami Rad, Ahmed Abbasi, Robert O Cotes, Gari D Clifford
pmc-10646674.description: BackgroundAutomatic speech recognition (ASR) technology is increasingly being used for transcription in clinical contexts. Although there are numerous transcription services using ASR, few studies have compared the word error rate (WER) between different transcription services among different diagnostic groups in a mental health setting.

pmc-11312967.title: Psoriasis and Lupus Erythematosus—Similarities and Differences between Two Autoimmune Diseases
pmc-11312967.creator: Aleksandra Fijałkowska, Joanna Wojtania, Anna Woźniacka, Ewa Robak
pmc-11312967.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and psoriasis (Ps) are two clinically distinct diseases with different pathogenesis. However, recent studies indicate some similarities in both clinical presentation and pathogenetic mechanisms. The coexistence of both entities is very uncommon and has not been fully elucidated. Thus, it remains a diagnostic and therapeutic challenge.

pmc-11336886.title: Isolation of anti-tumor monoclonal antibodies targeting on MICA/B α3 domain by single B cell technology for colon cancer therapy
pmc-11336886.creator: Xueyi Tang, Linhai He, Xiaoli Wang, Shuaichao Liu, Xiangning Liu, Xiaorui Shen, Yun Shu, Ke Yang, Qionghua Zhou, Zujian Shan, Yueming Wang, Changwen Wu, Zhenxing Jia, Tong Liu, Yayu Wang, Hua-Xin Liao, Yun Xia
pmc-11336886.description: Colon cancer (CC) is one of the most common gastrointestinal malignancies. Effectiveness of the existing therapies is limited. Immunotherapy is a promising complementary treatment approach for CC. Major histocompatibility complex class I-related protein A and B (MICA/B) are ligands for NK cells.

pmc-11352480.title: Implication of Capillary Morphogenesis Gene 2 (CMG2) in the Disease Progression and Peritoneal Metastasis of Pancreatic Cancer
pmc-11352480.creator: Ziqian Fang, Carly Bunston, Yali Xu, Fiona Ruge, Laijian Sui, Ming Liu, Bilal Al-Sarireh, Paul Griffiths, Kate Murphy, Matthew R. Pugh, Chunyi Hao, Wen G. Jiang, Lin Ye
pmc-11352480.description: Simple SummaryPancreatic cancer remains as one of the most life-threatening cancers with a 5-year overall survival rate less than 6%. As a transmembrane protein, capillary formation gene 2 (CMG2) mediates cell–matrix adhesion and migration. Recent studies have revealed emerging roles of CMG2 in various cancers.

pmc-11427438.title: Comparative analysis of superovulated versus uterine-embryo synchronized recipients for embryo transfer in cynomolgus monkeys (Macaca fascicularis)
pmc-11427438.creator: Dong-Ho Lee, Seung-Bin Yoon, Yu-Jin Jo, Jun Won Mo, Jeongwoo Kwon, Sang Il Lee, Jungkee Kwon, Ji-Su Kim
pmc-11427438.description: IntroductionAssisted reproductive technologies (ARTs), such as intracytoplasmic sperm injection and embryo transfer, are essential for generating genetically edited monkeys. Despite their importance, ARTs face challenges in recipient selection in terms of time and the number of animals required. The potential of superovulated monkeys, commonly used as oocyte donors, to serve as surrogate mothers, remains underexplored.

pmc-11658265.title: Cuticular wax in wheat: biosynthesis, genetics, and the stress response
pmc-11658265.creator: Ruiyang Tian, Wendi Liu, Yuhai Wang, Wenqiang Wang
pmc-11658265.description: All terrestrial plants possess a hydrophobic cuticle in the outermost layer of their aerial organs that is composed of cutin and wax. The cuticle serves as the first barrier between the plant and the surrounding environment and plays a key role in the resistance of plants to abiotic and biotic stressors.

pmc-12758100.title: Arsenic Exposure and Neurodevelopmental Disorders in Children: A Cross‑Sectional Study
pmc-12758100.creator: Claudia López, Paola Rubilar, María P Muñoz, Macarena Hirmas-Adauy, Verónica Iglesias
pmc-12758100.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: Arsenic exposure has been identified as a possible risk factor for neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs). In Arica, research has been conducted to relate arsenic exposure to the prevalence of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). However, highlighting the need to explore other events, such as autism spectrum disorder (ASD), this study aimed to evaluate the association between current urinary arsenic concentration and the prevalence of NDDs in children from Arica.Methods: A cross‑sectional study was conducted using secondary data from the FONIS project #SA22I0119.

pmc-13465751.title: Perspectives of mothers regarding infant swaddling and hip health in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia: Behavioral trends and associated determinants
pmc-13465751.creator: Hays S. Alfawaz, Rana A. Alhazzani, Abdulrhman A. Almazrou, Alhassna Alkahmous, Nourah A. Alkahmous, Omar A. Alkahmous, Aram Aldughayyim, Shatha Y. Asiri, Mastourah A. Alshahrani, Sarah A. Alessa, Ameerah S. Assiry, Khulood Y. Almaddi, Abdulelah F. Alshehri
pmc-13465751.description: Background:Infant swaddling that restricts physiological hip flexion and abduction has been identified as a modifiable postnatal risk factor for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH). Despite increasing biomechanical evidence linking improper swaddling techniques to adverse hip development, caregiver-related determinants of hip-safe swaddling practices remain insufficiently characterized in Middle Eastern populations.

pmc-13583918.title: Enhanced CO2 conversion via synergistic effect of dielectric barrier discharge plasma and halogen-modified g-C3N4
pmc-13583918.creator: Mudadla Umamaheswara Rao, Phyu Phyu Cho, Devthade Vidyasagar, Sneha Joseph, Shibani Patel, Guo-Ping Chang-Chien, Srinivaas Masimukku, Giridhar Madras, Challapalli Subrahmanyam
pmc-13583918.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Carbon dioxide (CO2) conversion is a key challenge in addressing global warming and the associated climate change. Non-thermal plasma activation of CO2 is a viable alternative to traditional thermal catalytic routes for converting CO2 into CO and O2. In this study, a dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) plasma reactor operated under ambient conditions was developed and demonstrated for CO2 conversion to CO. The integration of halogen-modified g-C3N4 markedly enhanced CO2 conversion relative to the unpacked condition.
